metadata.name: vicinity_curve
metadata.description: Vicinity Curve: one coin per city with its own bonding curve, graduation into its own pool, fee buckets, payouts and buyback-and-burn, without Meteora (VICINITY-CURVE-DESIGN.md)

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: 4.3. Step two of the admin transfer, signed by the proposed key.

instructions.name: add_launch_config
docs: 4.6. Add a split and curve for future coins (V1 to V11).

instructions.name: approve_launch
docs: 4.8. Approve one founder to launch one city's coin.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Pays the approval rent (refunded on close to `rent_payer = admin`).

accounts.name: legacy_launchpad
docs: read by hand: owner, size and discriminator, then `launches_paused`.

instructions.name: buy
docs: 4.11. Exact-in buy on the curve or in the pool.

accounts.name: user
docs: Pays `charged` lamports by a system transfer, so it must be a

accounts.name: user_token_account
docs: Any token account of this mint (a router may deliver to an account it
controls), except one whose authority is the `Coin` PDA (the vault or
any other), from which coins could never move again.

accounts.name: launchpad
docs: Only `buys_halted` is read (a buyback is a buy).

accounts.name: mint
docs: Writable: a burn lowers the supply.

instructions.name: forward_holders_fees
docs: 4.15. Permissionless: pay `holders_pending` to the city's checked

accounts.name: launchpad
docs: `admin` is read: the rewards config's authority must equal it.

accounts.name: rewards_city_config
docs: rewards program and the address is derived from the coin mint; the
handler reads and checks its fields.

accounts.name: rewards_vault
docs: The city's rewards vault: derived from the config under the rewards
program, a classic WSOL token account owned by the config PDA.

instructions.name: init_launchpad
docs: 4.1. One-time: create the global `Launchpad`. Only the program's upgrade
authority can call it; the admin signs too.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Becomes `launchpad.admin`; signs so the stored admin is a live key.

accounts.name: upgrade_authority
docs: Must be the program's current upgrade authority.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: loader and the address is derived from this program id; the handler
reads the upgrade authority from its 45-byte header.

instructions.name: launch
docs: 4.10. The approved founder launches the city's coin.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays every rent, the launch fee and Metaplex's own fee (usually the

accounts.name: legacy_launchpad
docs: discriminator), whose launches must be paused.

accounts.name: rent
docs: Required by the Metaplex CPI wrapper.

instructions.name: opt_in_payout
docs: 4.18. The founder opts in to daily payouts to the payout wallet.

instructions.name: payout_founder_fees
docs: 4.20. The payout key pays an opted-in founder's share to the payout

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: 4.2. Step one of the admin transfer (zero cancels).

instructions.name: revoke_approval
docs: 4.9. Close a pending approval (the admin, or anyone once expired).

instructions.name: revoke_payout_opt_in
docs: 4.19. Close a payout opt-in (current founder or its signer).

instructions.name: sell
docs: 4.12. Exact-in sell on the curve or in the pool.

accounts.name: user
docs: Owns `user_token_account` and receives `sol_out` lamports. If it holds
0 lamports, the payout must reach the rent-exempt minimum of an empty
account or the runtime refuses the transaction (14.3).

accounts.name: launchpad
docs: never read, so no setting can stop an exit.

accounts.name: user_token_account
docs: The seller's token account of this mint.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: Unused; keeps the account list identical to `buy`'s.

instructions.name: set_launch_config_enabled
docs: 4.7. Switch a config on or off for future approvals and launches.

instructions.name: set_pause
docs: 4.4. Pause or resume launches, payouts and buys. The payout key may
only pause payouts; the guardian may only pause launches and buys.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The admin, the payout key or the guardian.

instructions.name: set_payout_config
docs: 4.5. Set (or clear, with two zeros) the payout key and payout wallet.

instructions.name: transfer_founder
docs: 4.17. The founder hands the seat to a co-signing key.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: signer is not allowed to do this

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: signer is not the program's upgrade authority

errors.name: InvalidAddress
errors.msg: a pinned address, PDA, owner, size or discriminator check failed

errors.name: NoPendingAdmin
errors.msg: no admin transfer is pending

errors.name: NotPendingAdmin
errors.msg: signer is not the pending admin

errors.name: LaunchesPaused
errors.msg: launches are paused

errors.name: PayoutsPaused
errors.msg: payouts are paused

errors.name: PayoutsNotConfigured
errors.msg: opted-in payouts are not configured

errors.name: PayoutKeyNotSeparate
errors.msg: the admin, the payout key and the payout wallet must be three different keys, and neither payout key nor payout wallet may be the fee recipient

errors.name: ConfigDisabled
errors.msg: this launch config is disabled

errors.name: ConfigCount
errors.msg: 65,535 launch configs reached

errors.name: ConfigFeeTotal
errors.msg: V1: the five fee shares must add up to 1 to 250 basis points

errors.name: ConfigFeeShareCap
errors.msg: V2: platform share above 1.2% or founder share above 1.0%

errors.name: ConfigSupply
errors.msg: V3: curve and pool supplies out of range

errors.name: ConfigCurveBounds
errors.msg: V4: virtual reserves out of range, or a buyback cap could be 0

errors.name: ConfigGraduation
errors.msg: V5: the curve must complete at exactly graduation_sol (1 to 10,000 SOL) and the last buy must add at least one lamport

errors.name: ConfigAbsorption
errors.msg: V6: the curve would leave dust (x0 * y0 > (y0 - S)^2)

errors.name: ConfigContinuity
errors.msg: V7: the pool must open at most 1 part per billion below the curve's last price, never above

errors.name: ConfigBuybackMev
errors.msg: V8: the buyback could be sandwiched at a profit

errors.name: ConfigLaunchFee
errors.msg: V9: launch fee above 0.5 SOL

errors.name: BadSymbol

errors.name: BadExpiry
errors.msg: expiry must be in the future and at most 30 days away

errors.name: ApprovalNotExpired

errors.name: CoinAlreadyLaunched

errors.name: TickerTaken

errors.name: WrongFounder

errors.name: ZeroAmount

errors.name: WrongRewardsConfig

errors.name: WrongRewardsVault

errors.name: DestinationMismatch
errors.msg: payout destination does not match

errors.name: OptInFounderMismatch

errors.name: PayoutTooSoon

errors.name: ConfigBuybackHorizon

errors.name: LegacyApprovalExists

errors.name: LegacyLaunchesOpen

181 bytes (3.6). Closed by `launch` or `revoke_approval`, rent to

fields.name: founder
docs: Offset 16. The only wallet that may launch this city's coin.

fields.name: config_id
docs: Offset 48. The config the coin must use.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Offset 50. Receives the rent on close.

fields.name: meta_hash
docs: Offset 82. SHA-256 of the metadata JSON the website serves (3.10);

fields.name: sol_spent
docs: Lamports moved from `buyback_pending` into the reserve.

fields.name: tokens_burned
docs: Raw coins burned by this run.

fields.name: meta_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the metadata JSON the website serves at `uri` (3.10).

fields.name: dust_burned
docs: `COIN_SUPPLY - curve_supply - pool_supply`, burned in the same

fields.name: launch_fee
docs: Lamports paid to `FEE_RECIPIENT` in this instruction.

types.name: ConfigAdded
docs: `add_launch_config` (4.6): every field of the new config.

types.name: CurveCoin
docs: One per city, permanent; seeds `["coin", city_id u64 LE]`; 693 bytes with
fixed offsets (3.7). This file calls it `Coin`; the Rust name gives it the
All of the coin's SOL is held as native lamports of this account
(`rent_reserve` + the reserve of its phase + the five buckets, plus any
donation); its coins sit in the vault PDA `["coin_vault", coin]`.

fields.name: phase
docs: Offset 9. 0 Curve, 1 Pool; only 0 to 1, once.

fields.name: config_id
docs: Offset 13. Config it launched under (display; terms are copied below).

fields.name: founder
docs: Offset 87. Receives the founder share; changes only in `transfer_founder`.

fields.name: dust_burned
docs: Offset 181. `COIN_SUPPLY - S - P`, burned at launch.

fields.name: curve_sol
docs: Offset 197. `r = f(s)` on the curve; frozen at `R` after graduation.

fields.name: liquidity_pending
docs: Offset 221. `L`: curve-phase liquidity share not yet in the pool.

fields.name: holders_pending
docs: Offset 245. Owed to the rewards vault.

fields.name: buyback_pending
docs: Offset 253. Waiting to be spent on buyback.

fields.name: last_buyback_slot
docs: Offset 293. Rate limit (= `launch_slot` until the first buyback).

fields.name: tokens_burned
docs: Offset 333. Raw coins burned by buybacks.

fields.name: buy_volume
docs: Offset 341. Lifetime lamports charged to buyers (fee included).

fields.name: sell_volume
docs: Offset 357. Lifetime gross lamports released to sellers (before fee).

fields.name: liquidity_earned
docs: Offset 389. Lifetime liquidity share, rounding remainders included.

fields.name: liquidity_added
docs: Offset 405. Lifetime lamports moved into `pool_sol` by liquidity

fields.name: buyback_spent
docs: Offset 549. Lamports moved from the buyback bucket into the reserve.

fields.name: rent_reserve
docs: Offset 597. `Rent::minimum_balance(693)` at launch: the rent part of

types.name: Graduated
docs: The buy that takes the last curve coin (5.6).

fields.name: liquidity_pending
docs: The curve-phase liquidity set aside for the drip (5.8).

fields.name: last_virtual_sol
docs: The curve's last virtual reserves, `(x0 + R, y0 - S)`.

types.name: LaunchConfig
docs: One per allowed split and curve; seeds `["config", config_id u16 LE]`;

fields.name: enabled
docs: Offset 10. Admin switch for new approvals and launches only.

types.name: Launchpad
docs: There is no fee-recipient field, no program-id field and no coin counter

fields.name: admin
docs: Offset 8. Approves launches, adds and enables configs, sets any pause
flag either way, sets the payout key and wallet and the guardian.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Offset 40. Second step of an admin transfer; zero = none.

fields.name: payout_authority
docs: Offset 72. Key that may run opted-in founder payouts; zero = off.

fields.name: payout_destination
docs: Offset 104. System-owned wallet that receives opted-in payouts; zero = off.

fields.name: guardian
docs: Offset 136. May only set `launches_paused` and `buys_halted` to true;

fields.name: buys_halted
docs: Offset 170. Blocks `buy`, `buyback_burn` and `launch`; never an exit.

fields.name: next_config_id
docs: Offset 171. Id of the next `LaunchConfig`; sequential from 0.

types.name: PauseChanged
docs: `set_pause` (4.4): the flags after the change and who changed them.

types.name: PayoutOptIn
docs: One per coin while its founder is opted in; seeds `["payout_opt_in",

fields.name: founder
docs: Offset 40. Who signed; must still equal `coin.founder` at every payout.

fields.name: agreed_destination
docs: Offset 72. Copy of `launchpad.payout_destination` when the founder
signed; every payout must match it and the current setting.

fields.name: ref_hash
docs: Offset 104. SHA-256 of the off-chain reference, never a name or an

fields.name: founder
docs: The founder who signed the opt-in.

types.name: TickerLock
docs: One per ticker, permanent; seeds `["ticker", symbol bytes]`; 49 bytes (3.8).

fields.name: phase
docs: Phase the trade executed in (0 Curve, 1 Pool); a graduating buy

fields.name: sol_amount
docs: Buy: lamports charged. Sell: gross lamports released before the fee.

fields.name: sol_net
docs: Buy: lamports into the curve or pool. Sell: lamports paid to the user.

fields.name: liquidity_dripped
docs: Lamports moved from `liquidity_pending` into `pool_sol` (0 on the curve).

fields.name: partial
docs: `sol_amount < sol_in` (only the buy that completes the curve).

fields.name: graduated
docs: This buy completed the curve (a `Graduated` event follows).

fields.name: virtual_sol_after
docs: Virtual reserves of the market after the trade: curve

docs: An approval lasts at most 30 days.

constants.name: COIN_SUPPLY
docs: 1,000,000,000 coins at 6 decimals, minted once per coin (R8).

constants.name: CONTINUITY_PPB
docs: V7: the pool opens at most this many parts per 10^9 below the curve's last

constants.name: FEE_RECIPIENT
docs: R9: the only destination of platform fees and launch fees. Changing it

constants.name: LEGACY_LAUNCHES_PAUSED_AT
docs: Offset of `launches_paused` in the old program's `Launchpad`.

docs: LEGACY_PROGRAM_ID)` (mainnet build; unit test U12 checks the derivation).

constants.name: LEGACY_LAUNCHPAD_DISCRIMINATOR
docs: discriminator (equal to this program's, the struct keeps its name).

constants.name: LEGACY_LAUNCHPAD_LEN
docs: Size of the old program's `Launchpad` (discriminator, five Pubkeys,

constants.name: MAX_DUST_RAW
docs: Most raw units a config may burn at launch.

constants.name: MAX_LAUNCH_FEE_LAMPORTS
docs: R8 cap on a config's launch fee, 0.5 SOL.

constants.name: MAX_NAME_LEN
docs: Longest on-chain coin name (Metaplex limit), in bytes.

constants.name: MAX_SYMBOL_LEN
docs: Longest ticker (Metaplex limit), in bytes of `A-Z0-9`.

constants.name: MAX_TOTAL_FEE_BPS
docs: A config's five shares never add up to more than 2.5% (R2, V1).

constants.name: METADATA_URI_PREFIX
docs: Every coin's metadata URI is this prefix, the mint (base58) and ".json".

constants.name: METAPLEX_PROGRAM_ID
docs: Metaplex Token Metadata program (metadata for classic SPL coins).

constants.name: MEV_MAX_PERCENT
docs: V8: the conservative single-run bound is at most this percentage.

constants.name: MIN_TOTAL_FEE_BPS
docs: Smallest total fee of a config (V1).

constants.name: MIN_TRADE_LAMPORTS
docs: Smallest `sol_in` of a buy, 0.0001 SOL; sells have no minimum (O5).

constants.name: NATIVE_MINT
docs: Reward mint of every city's rewards vault (WSOL).

constants.name: PAYOUT_COOLDOWN_SECS
docs: At most one opted-in payout per coin per 24 hours.

constants.name: REWARDS_PROGRAM_ID
docs: Owner of every `vicinity_rewards` city config and vault the holders' share
may go to (mainnet build; the localnet tests load the real program here).
